exposure: red blood cell transfusion (receipt, timing, number)
outcome: neurodevelopmental outcomes (cognitive function, motor function, language function, severe neurodevelopmental impairment)
cohort: Preterm infants with a gestational age less than 34 weeks who received a full neurodevelopmental assessment at 18-36 months corrected age.
finding: Receipt of red blood cell transfusion was associated with decreased two-year cognitive and motor function, and an increasing number of transfusions was linked to worsened neurodevelopmental outcomes including cognitive, language, and motor function, and increased likelihood of severe neurodevelopmental impairment.
